The Thematic, Documents, Unplaced, and Dimensions doors are all empty — there is no existing node for a 'Quantum Widget Decision' or a 'PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration' in this graph. I expanded both available nodes to witness depth so the extraction passes can see the full context of who is acting and what decision framework exists, which is the only context this graph offers for a document about removing a decision and its associated migration knowledge.
